_meta.description: Generic target phrase library for query generation. Slot-level only — no card IDs. Describes who/what is affected; effects live in effects.json.
_meta.composition_rule: Pick one trigger phrase + one effect phrase + one target phrase per binding. Target phrases never include the effect verb.
_meta.card_mapping: Per-card target bindings live in parsed_cards.jsonl (parser output), not in this library.
_meta.name_placeholder: {name} only on SELF when referring to the permanent itself at compose time.

selection_modes.mass: affects a set without choosing one

_meta.candidate_render_note: candidate_render is for synthetic card text only. Existing phrases remain the query-generation phrase pool. Candidate target phrases must be short, grammatical fragments whose target/each/you wording is compatible with direct insertion into an effect template.

ANY.label: Any Target
ANY.note: Creature, player, or planeswalker. Broader than CREATURE.

EACH_CREATURE.label: Each Creature
EACH_CREATURE.note: Per-object application (damage to each). Distinct from ALL_CREATURES wipe wording.

RANDOM_CREATURE.label: Random Creature
RANDOM_CREATURE.note: Pool often uses random where Oracle would use target. Keep distinct for retrieval.

CREATURE.note: Use as a direct object after to, or after an effect verb such as destroy.

CREATURE_YOU_CONTROL.note: Keep target and controller restriction together so effect templates do not duplicate either phrase.

CREATURE_OPPONENT.note: Use the complete opponent-control restriction as the target fragment.

CREATURES_YOU_CONTROL.note: Use each rather than all so templates such as each creature you control gets remain grammatical.

ANY.note: This phrase already contains target; effect templates must not add another target word.

PLAYER.note: Use as a complete player target fragment.

OPPONENT.note: Use as a complete opponent target fragment or as the subject of an opponent-directed effect.

EACH_OPPONENT.note: The mass quantifier belongs here; effect templates should not add another each.

EACH_CREATURE.note: Use as a complete mass target fragment.

ALL_CREATURES.note: Use only where the effect semantics support an all-creatures scope.

SELF.note: The renderer should choose the subject form that agrees with the effect template and surrounding sentence.

YOU.note: Use as a subject or direct object without adding target.

PERMANENT.note: Use as a complete permanent target fragment.

NONLAND_PERMANENT.note: Keep the nonland restriction in the target fragment.

SPELL.note: Use as a complete spell target fragment.

ARTIFACT_OR_ENCHANTMENT.note: Use as a complete artifact-or-enchantment target fragment.

RANDOM_CREATURE.note: Do not add target; random selection is expressed by the fragment itself.

RANDOM_PERMANENT.note: Do not add target; random selection is expressed by the fragment itself.

GRAVEYARD_CREATURE.note: The reanimation effect template supplies the graveyard zone, avoiding duplicate wording such as from your graveyard twice.

LIBRARY_CARD.note: Search and put-onto-battlefield effect templates supply the library context; do not use a query fragment such as card you tutor.
